title:
Lal the ral the ra
 The rocky road to Dublin.
html_source:
“The Rocky Road to Dublin” is a traditional Irish ballad.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jxBKgOyMzSc

These lines also refer back to Deasy’s motto “Per vias rectas,” translated as by the straight roads
